name: @digitaplatform/veloluck-precise
description: Veloluck Precise: a FREE signature of Veloluck GmbH, the fictional bike workshop and shop that opens digita show; the workshop as a lab: cobalt #2F5BEA, neutral greys, a fine grid and a sharp diagonal, Inter in every role. One of three looks the company chooses from in the signature menu. Made from signature.json by make-signature, which refuses a text or control pair below WCAG AA except step 600 drawn as text, which no brand colour passes in both modes until digita-platform#240; ships as pure config (no runtime CSS).
